label: H.R. 8665
title: Allied Defense Sales Act

items.snippet: This bill directs the Department of State to implement a strategy to encourage foreign entities to participate in a multinational military procurement process.
The State Department must also periodically report on the strategy and its implementation.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

Z000018.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
Z000018.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
Z000018.note: OpenFEC returned no itemized individual contributions by employer for this committee in the 2026 cycle. The most recent completed cycle (2024) was also checked: no itemized employer rows were returned. Cycles are never combined.
